numerical_review.scope: Coefficient transcription, FIR history/EOS, K-weighting/windows/gates, bounded transactional input, chunk and test correctness.
numerical_review.checks: 7 peak integration tests, 9 loudness integration tests, 16 audio library tests and strict crate Clippy passed; independent FFmpeg loudnorm reference retained.
numerical_review.followup: The abrupt 10 kHz difference is boundary reconstruction sensitivity, not an Annex 2 implementation fault. Complete finite-sinc edge scan -22.55733955 dB lies between Deadpan -22.70394665 and FFmpeg -22.2; source/result retained. This is not a certified global maximum.

findings.finding: Direct report writes may leave a partial destination after write failure.
findings.resolution: Write and sync a same-directory tempfile, then persist without clobbering; a real 32-byte write limit leaves neither report nor temporary file.

findings.finding: FFmpeg peak readings were recorded but not compared or qualified.
findings.resolution: Both implementations must meet the published EBU 15-19 expectations. Arbitrary waveform comparisons remain explicit diagnostics; retain the failed generic0.4dB comparison and high-10000 mismatch rather than widening the tolerance. Empty input is explicitly inapplicable.

general_review.followup: Final changed harness and documentation reviewed; no new issues.

qualification_limitations: Unfaded10kHz finite-filter peak difference0.50394665dB remains; this is not a final-master safety qualification.
Official EBU programme archive was not tested.
Three limiter prototypes remain unqualified; full-sinc counterexamples retained.
